subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should steipete/bird remain hidden/deprecated, be republished or aliased to the confirmed replacement, or receive a broader unavailable-skill UX?
rationale: Current main has no Bird payload to patch, the old upstream is still gone, and the live API 404 avoids the broken command but does not prove the intended old-slug or replacement policy.

options.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
options.body: Verify the upstream intent, then update or republish the skill metadata, add an alias only if Birdclaw is the same product, or mark the old slug deprecated/unavailable.

options.title: Keep the old slug hidden
options.body: If Bird was intentionally removed, preserve the current public 404 behavior and record that owner/admin decision before closing.

options.title: Build unavailable-skill UX
options.body: If maintainers want removed skills to remain user-visible, add a source-backed hidden/deprecated page flow rather than editing this one record ad hoc.

recommendation.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream intent, then update or republish the skill metadata, add an alias only if Birdclaw is the same product, or mark the old slug deprecated/unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The namespace, old tap/repo, possible Birdclaw replacement, and admin handle make this the clearest owner for deciding production skill intent.
